1: // Simple top‑down endless runner for canvas with id "game"

11:   };
12:   resize();
13:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
14: 
15:   // player ship
16:   const player = {
17:     x: canvas.width / 2,
18:     y: canvas.height - 60,
19:     size: 20,
20:     speed: 4,
21:     dx: 0,
22:     dy: 0,
23:   };
24:   const keys = {};
25:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
26:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
27:   // audio setup
28:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
29:   const playBeep = (freq, dur) => {
30:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
31:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
32:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
33:     osc.type = 'sine';
34:     osc.connect(gain);
35:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
36:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
37:     osc.start();
38:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
39:   };
40:   // asteroids and power‑ups
41:   const asteroids = [];
42:   const powerUps = [];
43:   let spawnTimer = 0;
44:   let puTimer = 0;
45:   let score = 0;
46:   let gameOver = false;
47: 
48:   const rnd = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
49: 
50:   // spawn a background star
51:   const spawnStar = () => {
52:     const size = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
53:     stars.push({
54:       x: rnd(0, canvas.width),
55:       y: -size,
56:       size,
57:       speed: rnd(0.5, 1.5),
58:     });
59:   };
60: 
61:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
62:     const radius = rnd(10, 30);
63:     asteroids.push({
64:       x: rnd(radius, canvas.width - radius),
65:       y: -radius,
66:       r: radius,
67:       speed: rnd(1, 3) + score * 0.005,
68:     });
69:   };
70: 
71:   const spawnPowerUp = () => {
72:     const size = 12;
73:     powerUps.push({
74:       x: rnd(size, canvas.width - size),
75:       y: -size,
76:       size,
77:       speed: 2,
78:     });
79:   };
80: 
81:   const updatePlayer = () => {
82:     player.dx = 0; player.dy = 0;
83:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.dx = -player.speed;
84:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.dx = player.speed;
85:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) player.dy = -player.speed;
86:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) player.dy = player.speed;
87:     player.x = Math.max(player.size, Math.min(canvas.width - player.size, player.x + player.dx));
88:     player.y = Math.max(player.size, Math.min(canvas.height - player.size, player.y + player.dy));
89:   };
90: 
91:   const rectCircleCollide = (rx, ry, rw, rh, cx, cy, cr) => {
92:     const distX = Math.abs(cx - rx - rw / 2);
93:     const distY = Math.abs(cy - ry - rh / 2);
94:     if (distX > rw / 2 + cr) return false;
95:     if (distY > rh / 2 + cr) return false;
96:     if (distX <= rw / 2) return true;
97:     if (distY <= rh / 2) return true;
98:     const dx = distX - rw / 2;
99:     const dy = distY - rh / 2;
100:     return dx * dx + dy * dy <= cr * cr;
101:   };
102: 
103:   const update = () => {
104:     if (gameOver) return;
105:     // spawn timers
106:     spawnTimer++;
107:     if (spawnTimer > 60) { spawnAsteroid(); spawnTimer = 0; }
108:     puTimer++;
109:     if (puTimer > 500) { spawnPowerUp(); puTimer = 0; }
110:     starTimer++;
111:     if (starTimer > 5) { spawnStar(); starTimer = 0; }
112:     updatePlayer();
113:     // move stars (background)
114:     for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {

118:     }
119:     // move asteroids

121:       const a = asteroids[i];

124:       // collision with player (approx ship as rectangle)

128:       }
129:     }
130:     // move power‑ups
131:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
132:       const p = powerUps[i];
133:       p.y += p.speed;
134:       if (p.y - p.size > canvas.height) { powerUps.splice(i, 1); continue; }
135:       // collect
136:       if (rectCircleCollide(player.x - player.size, player.y - player.size, player.size * 2, player.size * 2, p.x, p.y, p.size)) {
137:         player.speed += 0.5; // temporary boost
138:         powerUps.splice(i, 1);

141:       }
142:     }

162:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.size, player.y + player.size);

175:     // power‑ups

183:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
184:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';

189:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';

191:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
192:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
